item.title: COMING Saturday August 15 | Dirty Logic: A Steely Dan Tribute — Mon Aug 3 — Pisgah Brewing Company Black Mountain
item.description:
Saturday, August 15 | Show: 7:30 pm | Outdoor Stage | $36.15 adv. Event Details and Tickets Dirty Logic will be performing at Pisgah Brewing Company on Friday, August 15 for a full evening of Steely Dan classics—set against the backdrop of one of Western North Carolina’s favorite outdoor stages. Bring a lawn chair, settle in, and make an evening of it!
This 11-piece band draws from some of Asheville’s finest musicians, united by a shared love and deep reverence for the Steely Dan songbook. What you’ll hear is more than faithful reproduction—it’s a heartfelt celebration of one of the most sophisticated and enduring catalogs in American music. The iconic hits, the deep cuts, the intricate solos, and the funkier live arrangements that longtime fans treasure.
Every show is both a careful honoring of the studio recordings and a living, breathing musical experience—the kind that reminds you why this music has stayed with people for decades.

item.title: Scenic AVL #7: Scott Mountain — Mon Aug 3, 6:00 PM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group The hike is on Monday this week because the weather is better than Tuesday. The path will be muddy.
There is very limited parking at the [trailhead](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fETct2fiMiLz1HEG8). Please plan to meet at Lake Hills Church parking lot at 10 minutes before the start to condense cars. Lake Hills Church Parking Lot is pictured above. - [https://maps.app.goo.gl/X1TctrhYv3gihmh66](https://maps.app.goo.gl/X1TctrhYv3gihmh66) *Call the hike leader at 828-290-0886 if you cannot find us. Do not text.
**Rating**: Moderate **Elevation**: 800 **Distance**: 5 miles **Surface**: Trail **Pace**: 3 mph **Dogs**: on leash. **Gear**: Long pants recommended, bug spray, water. The ticks are bad on this trail. Bring your bug spray ! **Features**: wooded trail, interesting plants and fungi. item.description: Friday, August 21 • 4 PM – 11 PM | Event Details and Tickets Our annual Brew Ridge Jam returns to Asheville, NC on August 21st at French Broad River Brewery with special guests Empire Strikes Brass & Coyote Rodeo. Don’t miss out on the free beer tasting and indoor taproom music featuring JR and ScareKrow from 4-6PM. Leftover Salmon is an American jam band from Boulder, Colorado, formed in 1989. The band’s music is a blend of bluegrass, rock, country, and Cajun/Zydeco. In their fourth decade as a band, Leftover Salmon’s current lineup has been together longer than any other and is one of their strongest ever. Built around founding members Drew Emmitt and Vince Herman, the band is now powered by banjo wizard Andy Thorn, the steady rhythm section of bassist Greg Garrison and drummer Alwyn Robinson, along with dobro and keyboard player Jay Starling. item.description:
Awakening Asheville You do not have to walk this path alone. In fact, this journey is that much more rich and enjoyable when traversed with others. Groups Openings
First Saturday of each month – mornings at 10:30 am Eastern Led by Buddhist teacher Ronya Banks, this group meets once a month, for an hour and a half.
Group Meeting Includes: Group Discussion and Sharing Instruction on Dharma/Buddhist Principles Guided Meditation Meditation Instruction Connecting with Other Practitioners Most people on a spiritual journey find it supportive, often even necessary to get the regular support of a meditation teacher, as well as the mutuality and connection with other meditation practitioners on this path.
This monthly group affords you with the opportunity to connect with a teacher and other like-minded people, wherein you will all boldly delve deeply into different ways of approaching your formal and informal mindfulness practices through the lens of the Buddhist teachings.

item.title: Warren Wilson Berea Baptist Church Hike — Fri Aug 14, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Asheville Mountains-to-Sea Trail Hiking Club 2.0 We'll meet at 9:00 a.m. on Riceville Road, across from Berea Baptist church and plan to leave no later than 9:10 a.m.
We'll hike in the woods along the Bull Creek Trail and over to the Swannanoa River trail and back. This is a gently undulating hike through serene woods and along peaceful waterways. We hike at about 3.2 mph.
Then length of this trail is 5-6 miles, depending upon how far we hike along the river; and we will return to the cars by 11:00 to 11:15. Well behaved dogs on leashes are welcome.
Mountains-to-Sea-Trail hikes are designed for fitness and community among people who are already reasonably fit. It's not an endurance hike by any means, but it is designed so we can get our hearts beating a bit while still being able to have a conversation and meet new people. The typical pace for a hike of this sort is 3.0 to 3.2 mph.

item.title: Adult Studio: Papermaking — Sat Aug 29, 12:00 PM — NC
item.description: This 4 hour workshop will introduce the basics of hand papermaking along with a guided tour of the Exhibition. Participants will learn to make several sheets of handmade paper that they can add botanicals to or embellish with pigmented pulps. We will conclude with pressing the handmade sheets so they will be ready to take away at the conclusion of the workshop! Georgia Deal is a printmaker / papermaker who makes mixed-media works on handmade paper. She is Professor Emeritus and former chair of the Printmaking & Papermaking programs at the Corcoran College of Art & Design in Washington D.C. Currently, she resides in Asheville, NC and is the proprietor of Swannanoa Paper, a collaborative studio that also offers workshops. Deal has taught courses throughout the U.S., at Penland School in NC, Haystack Mtn. School, ME the Paper & Book Intensive, Oxbow, MI, and abroad in Cortona, Italy, Skopelos, Greece and San Miguel, Mexico. Her works are in the collections of the Library of Congress,

item.title: Shut Up & Write - South Asheville — Sun Aug 30, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Coworking for writers in your area! Join us for some focused writing time. All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
Please arrive a few minutes early to say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.
Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
A note about the format We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.
For our full event schedule, visit https://shutupwrite.com

item.title: The Hope of Oz by Montford Players — Fri Oct 16, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville Introverts Set a decade after Dorothy’s defeat of the Wicked Witch of the West and her subsequent departure, The Hope of Oz brings us to a newly invigorated Capital where the Wizard’s power has grown immensely with constant systematic oppression on his denizens and waging a drug-fueled war with the new cadre of Witches that brings its citizens to their knees. The story follows Gale, an investigative “Witch-hunter,” on the trail of East’s assassination. Trapped in a bar with a synthetic (known as mimics), surrounded by encroaching revolutionaries, Witches, and the Wizard’s ever watchful eyes, Gale must survive the night if Oz will see its dawn. But in an empire of extremes, who can survive?
The show begins at 7:30pm. Stepped ground seating is free, remember to bring blankets, pillows, campchairs, etc to be more comfortable. If you’d like to make an online donation before the show you can do so here: [https://www.montfordparkplayers.org/](https://www.montfordparkplayers.org/ge
